description_ru: Реестр renderer adapters. Наличие ключа в каталоге обозначает только маршрутизацию задания; фактическая реализация и принятие медиа указаны в status.

adapter_contract.frame_count_policy: variants_may_differ; preserve semantic phase timings and validate loop seam per profile

adapters.input_bridge: animation-pipeline/exercises/pull_up.json (renderer-specific; catalog-to-renderer bridge not yet automated)
adapters.contact_model: fixed horizontal bar, closed overhand grip on bar axis
known_limits: Finger closure is currently under fresh rerender review; do not publish media before visual grip review.

adapters.contact_model: both palms and both feet or knees remain on floor; whole trunk moves as one supported chain
known_limits: Bodyweight push must not reuse pull-up arm rotations.

adapters.contact_model: both feet remain grounded; knees track toward toe direction
known_limits: Depth is individualized; don't gate one universal hip depth.

adapters.contact_model: hands fixed to floor; alternating leg motion must not bounce the pelvis
known_limits: Validate left/right semantic parity and avoid exaggerated hip oscillation.

adapters.contact_model: stable foot/optional bench support; hand-held dumbbell follows a controlled arc without torso rotation
known_limits: Keep exercise setup distinct from two-arm bent-over row, cable row and kettlebell row.

adapters.contact_model: bar remains supported at front shoulders; elbows remain high; bar path stays over mid-foot
known_limits: Use a separate adapter/profile for Smith machine; do not fake it by attaching a moving barbell to the hands.

adapters.contact_model: hands and knees remain grounded while spine flexes/extends through a comfortable arc
known_limits: Do not exaggerate lumbar hyperextension or animate the head independently.

adapters.contact_model: seat travels on rail; feet stay strapped; handle and elbows follow leg-body-arm sequencing
known_limits: Drive order: legs, then trunk, then arms; return order is arms, trunk, legs.

adapters.contact_model: dumbbells follow hands; elbows remain near torso; shoulder swing is constrained
known_limits: Differentiate a seated/incline curl and EZ-bar variant as separate setup parameters.

adapters.contact_model: hands remain on wheel handles; wheel rolls along floor; trunk stays within controlled anti-extension range
known_limits: Enforce a controlled range; must not infer safe max extension from a reference drawing.

adapters.contact_model: forearms and toes remain grounded; trunk stays within a bounded plank line
known_limits: A hold needs an exit pose/timing policy rather than a forced looping repetition.
